● Online reputation management

Online reputationmanagement that earns trustin India.

Genuine reviews, thoughtful replies and accurate profiles, so the picture a buyer, parent or student finds before they contact you is a fair one.

See how it works

In short

Online reputation management is the work of making sure the ratings, reviews and profiles people find about you are accurate, current and a fair picture of your business.

Monday Marketing Company (MMC) manages reputation for education brands, B2B companies and D2C brands, with a focus on genuine reviews and honest replies.

  • Audit firstWe map what people see on Google, review sites and social before we change anything.
  • Genuine reviewsWe help you ask real customers, parents and students, and reply to every review.
  • Reported monthlyRatings, review volume, response time and the themes behind them.
Where reputation goes missing

Five ways a doubtful buyer is lost before they call.

Buyers, parents and students check you before they contact you. Each stage below is a place that check can go wrong, and the work that prevents it.

  1. 1
    Stage 1 of 5See what they see

    Not knowing what people find when they search your name.

    Most people look you up before they enquire. If you have never checked what shows up, you are guessing at the first impression.

    What we do

    We audit your ratings, reviews, profiles and search results across Google, review sites and social, and show you what a prospective customer sees.

    Reputation audit
  2. 2
    Stage 2 of 5Earn more real reviews

    Hoping happy customers will leave reviews on their own.

    Unhappy customers are more likely to post unprompted, so a few loud complaints can outweigh many quiet, satisfied customers.

    What we do

    We set up simple, honest ways to ask genuine customers, parents and students for a review at the right moment, within each platform's rules.

    Review generation
  3. 3
    Stage 3 of 5Reply to every review

    Leaving reviews unanswered, or answering defensively.

    A reply is read by everyone who reads the review. A calm, specific answer shows how you treat people when something goes wrong.

    What we do

    We draft and manage replies to positive and negative reviews in your voice, and pass genuine problems to your team to resolve.

    Response management
  4. 4
    Stage 4 of 5Keep the facts right

    Old hours, wrong phone numbers and half-filled profiles.

    Out-of-date or inconsistent information across listings makes a business look careless, and sends people to the wrong place.

    What we do

    We keep your profiles and listings accurate and consistent, with current photos, contact details and answers to common questions.

    Profile and listing management
  5. 5
    Stage 5 of 5Watch and report

    Finding out about a problem weeks after it started.

    Reputation changes gradually, then suddenly. Without regular reporting, a fall in rating or a new theme of complaints goes unnoticed.

    What we do

    We monitor ratings and reviews and report monthly on rating, review volume, response time and the themes behind what people say.

    Monitoring and reporting

Screens are illustrative recreations of each platform's interface, not client data. Platform names and logos belong to their owners.

Common questions

What people ask about reputation first.

What is online reputation management?

It is the work of managing the ratings, reviews, profiles and search results people find about you, so that the picture is accurate, current and fair.

Can you remove negative reviews?

We do not promise to remove reviews, and genuine reviews stay. We can flag content that breaks a platform's rules, respond well to criticism, and help you earn more genuine reviews.

Do you write or buy reviews?

No. We only help you ask real customers, parents and students for their honest views, and we do not create or buy reviews.

Which platforms do you cover?

Google and the review sites and directories that matter for your category, plus your social profiles. We agree the list after the audit.

Why does reputation matter for a college?

Parents and students check ratings and reviews before they apply. A doubtful picture at that last step can lose an enrolment that the rest of your marketing earned.

What does it cost?

It depends on scope and, for media, on ad spend, so we quote after the audit call, once we have seen your accounts.
